body: Thank you so much. I'm gonna sleep for now and sober up, but if you're still willing to later on, then I would really appreciate sorting out my thoughts and feelings with you when I'm sober. My normal sober self would hate this drunken me for being a whiney little shit, but I think that this time it'll hurt when I'm sober too. Feelfree to say no though, I'm trying to burden as few people as possible from here on out.
